role.label: Sales channels
role.help: Users with this role only see and change the orders and customers of these sales channels. Leave empty for no limit. A user with several roles gets the channels of all of them; one role without channels removes the limit.

preset.label: Permission presets
preset.applied: Preset "{name}" added to the permissions. Save the role to keep it.

help.orders: Adds everything the order module needs, including documents (create, upload, download, send, delete), refunds, discounts and payment states. Existing permissions stay. Note: deleting documents needs the Documents settings permission "delete", which also allows deleting document settings.
help.products: Adds everything the product module needs, including media, Shopping Experience layouts, reviews and the Commercial extensions on the product page (bundles, review summaries). Existing permissions stay.

product.readOnlyText: This product is also sold in sales channels outside your role. Its data applies to all of them, so only users responsible for every one of these channels can change it.
product.readOnlyTooltip: Read-only: the product is also sold in other sales channels
